_comment: Distribution limits use the worst observed value ± 3 sample SDs, rounded outward, from `npm run calibrate:phonemes` (30 non-overlapping RNG streams, sampleSize words, lexicon, morphology off). This is an engineering margin, not a false-failure probability guarantee. Inventory coverage is fixed at 0: calibration fails on any generated-only mass, missing CMU phonemes, or rejected tokens. Recalibration measures a change; justify any loosened limit with its linguistic benefit and leave unaffected limits unchanged. Shared Pearson r is reported but not gated (2026-11 recalibration). See TUNING.md. 2026-11-13: minRepresentation and maxAbsoluteGapPct loosened after forbidOpenCheckedFinal removed open-final /ɪ ɛ æ ʌ ʊ/ (issue #398); /ɪ/ under-rep and abs gap moved while TV/over-rep stayed within prior limits (5-seed recalibration). 2026-11-17: maxOverRepresentation loosened 1.066→1.08 after #440 banned illegal joins /z.ʃ/, /ʃ.h/, /k.tʃ/ (drop-coda repairs); seed-42 /u/ over-rep 1.063→1.068 and 30-stream worst 1.0679 (SD 0.0040). Other limits unchanged (observed extrema still inside prior bounds). Recalibrated on #451 head (pre-#443 revert) via `npm run calibrate:phonemes`. 2026-11-21: maxTotalVariationPct 1.78→1.88 to match the documented k=3 rule on main 81df038c (30 streams: min 1.6157, max 1.7714, mean 1.7084, SD 0.0342; max + 3 SD = 1.874). Main's TV drifted up through reviewed changes since 1.78 was set (2026-11 record on 30466c3: mean 1.5722, max 1.6531; now mean 1.7084, max 1.7714), leaving the limit 0.25 SD above the 30-stream worst, so spelling-only branches that merely reshuffle the seed-42 stream failed it (1.7825; paired 30-seed difference mean -0.0034, no shift). This re-applies the documented rule to that drift; other limits unchanged (all observed extrema inside them).
